name: MonitorPlanCommentDTO
description: MonitorPlanCommentDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

monitoringPlanComment.example: DAHS was updated for GT-1 on 11/10/2016 by a previous owner, but the component ID was not updated on the gas system. This was corrected on 9/8/2020.

beginDate.description: Date and time in which an activity started or ended.

endDate.description: Last date in which information was effective.  This date will be null for active records.

id.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring plan comment record.

planId.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring plan record.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.

active.description: Flag for active monitor location record
